title: feat(types)!: retire the eight Phase 3.5 validation types (objectui#10719)
body:
Fixes #10719
Clause-②: yes — eight public type exports of `@object-ui/types` are removed

## What this is

This PR executes the ruling that objectui#10719 inherits: maintainer ruling A on objectui#7659 (comment 5548579814, decision batch #40 item 4, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove), carried to the type half of the same vocabulary by triage comment 5851687727. `AdvancedValidationSchema`, `AdvancedValidationRule`, `ValidationRuleType`, `ValidationFunction`, `AsyncValidationFunction`, `ValidationContext`, `AdvancedValidationResult` and `AdvancedValidationError` typed only `@object-ui/core`'s `ValidationEngine`, which PR objectui#10709 retired. They leave `data-protocol.ts` and the package root, and the "Phase 3.5 … Complete Validation Engine" banner and their docblocks go with them.

⚠️ This is a breaking narrowing of a published package's exports. It is scored `minor`, per this repository's version-alignment convention.

## Stop condition: measured, not triggered

The ruling stops this change if any of the eight has a live reader. None was found.

| where | instrument | reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| objectui `packages` `apps` `examples` `content` `skills`, BASE `01700dcd7` | `git grep -c -w` per name, CHANGELOGs excluded | Every hit is in `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`, `packages/types/src/index.ts`, or the `plugin-form.mdx` near-spelling list (a doc, which moves with the retirement). The lit control `FieldValidationRules` answers in 12 files. |
| objectui whole tracked tree | `git grep -w` of all eight, outside the two home files | Hits only in the four pending changesets, `plugin-form.mdx`, and two `scripts/__tests__` files. In those two, the names are string fixtures and comments, not type readers. |
| objectstack `origin/main` `e2c4e12` | `git grep -w` of all eight | 0 files. Lit control: 37 files name `@object-ui/types`. |
| type reachability | the emitted `.d.ts` of the BASE build | Only `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/data-protocol.d.ts` name any of them. The family's only references are to each other. |
| subpath doors | `packages/types/package.json` `exports` | `data-protocol` is not a subpath; the root `.` is the only door. |
| out-of-repo consumers | none | NOT MEASURED: no consumer is named. Ruling A was taken with the same limit. |

## Changes

| file | change |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` | The Phase 3.5 banner, the eight declarations and their docblocks are deleted, with a `//` retirement note in their place. Declaration emit strips the note: 0 hits in the rebuilt `dist/data-protocol.d.ts`. The module header's `ValidationSchema` now reads `object-level validation rules`, because that header ships in the `.d.ts`. |
| `packages/types/src/index.ts` | The eight root re-exports and their comment line are removed. |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/phase35-validation-types-retired-10719.test.ts` | New barrel-absence pin (see below). |
| `.changeset/10719-retire-phase35-validation-types.md` | `'@object-ui/types': minor`, a BREAKING banner, the replacement, and the NOT MEASURED line for out-of-repo consumers. |
| `.changeset/9909-machine-locale-sweep.md`, `.changeset/7659-retire-validation-engine.md`, `.changeset/6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-2.md`, `.changeset/7357-retire-field-metadata-depends-on.md` | Each gets a dated in-body note, 2026-09-27, following the objectui#8522 → objectui#7742 precedent. Frontmatter is untouched. |
| `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` | The near-spelling list drops `AdvancedValidationRule` and `ValidationRuleType`. The pinned sentence "There is no `ValidationRule` type in this repository" stays. |

## The pin, and where it departs from the objectui#7659 shape

- **Compile time.** Sixteen `@ts-expect-error` probes: each of the eight, once through `import('../index.js')` and once through `import('../data-protocol.js')`. Three lit controls resolve through the same spellings with no directive. The file is compiled by `tsconfig.test.json` under `type-check`; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` confirms it is in the program. `noUnusedLocals` is off, so each directive's only possible diagnostic is the missing export.
- **Runtime.** `data-protocol.ts` and `index.ts` are read as text, through a declaration matcher and an export-list parser that strips comments first. Both carry lit controls: `ObjectValidationRule`, `FilterFieldConfig` and `FieldValidationRules`.
- ⚠️ **Departure, measured.** The objectui#7659 pin's runtime leg is `Object.keys(entry)`. All eight were `export type`. On the BASE build, where the names were still exported, the runtime namespace of `@object-ui/types` carried none of them, while `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/data-protocol.d.ts` still did. That leg reads the same before and after, so it cannot fail. The runtime half is therefore a source read, following the objectui#8800 and objectui#7519 pins in the same directory.

**Reverse verification.** The pin was committed at `cf364fe91`, then both source files were restored from BASE `01700dcd7` with the pin kept:

- `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`: exit 2, exactly 16 × TS2578 "Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive", 0 other errors.
- `vitest run` of the pin: exit 1, 2 of 2 failed, with "data-protocol.ts declares a retired Phase 3.5 validation type again." and "@object-ui/types re-exports a retired Phase 3.5 validation type again (objectui#10719)."
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- PATHS` in a trap. Both files' blob hashes equal the HEAD blobs, and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.

## Gates, final head `c68bc62ab`

Exit codes are captured before any pipe. Heavy runs went through the shared verify lock.

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/core^...' build` (the closure is `@object-ui/types`): exit 0. The rebuilt `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/data-protocol.d.ts` carry 0 of the eight.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/`: exit 0, 243 of 243 files, 5288 tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/`: exit 0, 173 of 173 files, 3504 tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 54 `scripts/__tests__` files that read `content/docs`, `.changeset/` or the types exports (derived by `git grep -l`): exit 0, 54 of 54 files, 2589 tests.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0 · `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0 · `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` 0 (report-only) · `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` 0 · `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0 (report-only) · `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 ("0 new citation(s)") · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check:spec-symbols` 0 · `check:test-path-roots` 0 · `type-check:coverage` 0 · `check:doc-types` 0 · `check-doc-links.mjs` 0 · `check:doc-fences` 0 · `check:doc-example-ids` 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on all nine paths: exit 0, "NOT GOVERNED".

**Consumer direction.** `@object-ui/core` is a downstream consumer of `@object-ui/types` and read the family before objectui#7659; its reading is green above. No other package imports any of the eight (see the census above), so the downstream sweep is that tree-scoped absence census, not a rebuilt consumer closure.

**ESLint, narrowed to the three touched `.ts` files.** The population comes from ESLint's own config: `--print-config` resolves for all three. The file count comes from `--format json`: 3 files. On invariance, `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `project`, `projectService` or `TypeChecked`), so the diff cannot move a verdict in any untouched file. In CI shape (inline config honoured): exit 0, with 0 errors and 36 warnings, all pre-existing `no-explicit-any` in `data-protocol.ts`. Under `--no-inline-config`: exit 1, on one error in `index.ts`. That error is the deliberate `eslint-disable no-restricted-imports` block around the `SpecFormField` alias. The BASE bytes of the same path give the same error (the control), so it predates this change.

**Not run locally, with reason:**

- Spec Main Shape Gate. It is owed where a touched type is spec-derived. The eight are hand-written (the removed block imports nothing from `@objectstack/spec`), and the spec-derived object-level rule types beside them are byte-unchanged. CI runs it.
- `pnpm check:readme-exports`. It needs every package built, and `packages/types/README.md` names none of the eight (see the census), so no README-named export can go missing. CI runs it.
- The full `scripts/__tests__` suite, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm check`. These are CI-owned.

## Acceptance notes

- `check-changeset-claims` (report-only) asked for a re-read of three pending paragraphs that name a touched file: `6051-gantt-flat-config-declared-keys.md` (the `GanttConfig` exports), `6237-wizard-step-config-split.md` (the tabbed-form support row) and `uniqueness-deprecation-jsdoc-4765.md` (the JSDoc on `UniquenessValidation`). Each is about a member this diff does not touch, and each stays true. The 4765 body's `dist/data-protocol.d.ts` byte figures describe that change's own delta; they are historical and are not re-addressed.
- `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only) lists the four dated notes as modifications of pre-existing changesets. They are its case 2: prose-only, with every declared package name kept.
- `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` keeps `'export interface AdvancedValidationRule {}'` and `"export type ValidationRuleType = 'required';"` as negative fixtures for its bare-`ValidationRule` matcher. The comment above them says every negative "is a spelling this repository really writes, cited where it lives", and they carry trailing cross-file line addresses into `data-protocol.ts`. After this change neither spelling is written anywhere, and the addresses point at deleted lines. The test stays green, because the fixtures are strings and remain valid negatives. The file is outside this claim's file surface, so it is not edited here. Carrier: none named.
- `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` mentions data-protocol's `ValidationFunction` in a past-tense note ("sat here"). It is still true as history and is untouched.
- Out-of-repo consumers of the eight are NOT MEASURED. The changeset says so, as objectui#7659's did.
- objectui#7469 also edits `packages/types/src/index.ts`, at the `App*` exports (a different region). Whichever of the two lands second merges `main`.
- `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts` still opens with "Phase 3.5: Validation module". That is core's live module (relabelled by objectui#10709), not this family, and it is untouched.
